property_summary: After any call to setOwner, the new owner must equal the _owner argument supplied; the buggy version sets any caller's supplied _owner, while the reference version reverts for non-admin callers, so the bug violates the invariant for non-admin callers.
Any non-admin caller must fail to change the owner via setOwner; the buggy modifier allows any caller to succeed.

Only the original admin should be able to change the owner; the buggy modifier lets any caller change the owner, so after setOwner is called by a non-admin, the owner state variable differs between the reference and the mutant.
For any non-reverting call to setOwner, the return value must be true; the bug version returns false, violating this invariant.
After a successful setOwner call, the contract's owner variable must equal the address passed; the bug still updates owner but returns false.
For any admin caller, setOwner always returns true in the reference but returns false in the mutant because the return statement was deleted.

The reference contract C only allows the admin (deployer) to change the owner via setOwner; the buggy version allows any caller to change the owner. This can be observed by checking that the owner only changes when called by admin in the reference, but may change for a non-admin in the buggy version.

After any call to setOwner, if the caller is not the admin, the owner state variable must remain unchanged in the reference; the buggy version violates this by allowing a non-admin to change the owner.
